lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A four-drawer cabinet of actual paper, because the Enclave keeps one physical copy of everything it cannot afford to have quietly edited. Personnel, procurement, incident reports.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: My own file is in here. Eleven years, four commendations, two training certifications, and one note added in the fourth year.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Asks too many questions about counterparties. That is the whole note. No recommendation, no follow-up, no signature I can place.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The note is dated seven years before tonight. Somebody has been waiting a long time to be right about you.
